credits.title: Crawlers
credits.overview: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

credits.title: Better Class
credits.overview: When middle-class parents Alicia and Gonzalo get their son Fer into an elite secular school, their quest to secure his future quickly exposes their own deep desire for upper-class status, wealth, and social prestige.

credits.title: Tenéis que verlo
credits.overview: Luis and Ana visit another couple of friends who have just had a baby. What promises to be a quick visit with the sole purpose of meeting the newborn ends up turning into a strange experience that reveals that neither the parents are as fine as they claim, nor the baby as normal as he seems…

credits.title: Rich Flu
credits.overview: A strange disease kills off some of the richest and most influential people on the planet. First it was the billionaires, then the multi-millionaires and so on progressively... credits.overview: Actress Maria, and filmmaker Luke, travelled from LA to Spain in March 2020 to get married. The pandemic caused them to cancel the wedding, and forced them into lockdown with Luke’s mum, Karen, who had travelled all the way from Australia. Luke filmed it all and put it online as a series. credits.title: Rifkin's Festival
credits.overview: The story of a married American couple who go to the San Sebastian Film Festival. They get caught up in the magic of the festival, the beauty and charm of Spain and the fantasy of movies. She has an affair with a brilliant French movie director, and he falls in love with a beautiful Spanish woman who lives there.

credits.title: Bad Impulse
credits.overview: In the aftermath of a traumatic event, a suburban husband and father buys a cutting edge home security system, only to find that it slowly destroys that which he most wants to protect.

credits.title: Bent
credits.overview: On his latest private investigation, a shamed former cop connects a murder case to a government conspiracy involving rogue agents from a top spy agency.

credits.title: Among Us
credits.overview: After the mysterious death of their young son, a couple desperately flees to a remote lake house to escape the unrelenting haunting following them only to discover the mysterious entity is still very much a part of their lives.

credits.title: The Hunter's Prayer
credits.overview: An assassin forges an unlikely partnership with one of his targets: a woman seeking revenge for the murder of her family.

credits.title: (Buried) Over the Roofs
credits.overview: Barcelona, 2010. Finding an apartment in the city is no longer possible. Three characters are looking for an alternative to find a place to drop dead.
